test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the meaning of ‘Lokayukta’ in the Constitution of India?

options.text: A body operating at the state level to investigate an individual's complaint against public servants or any politician with respect to corruption
A body operating at the central level to investigate the civil servant or politician with respect to complaint made against them for corruption
A body created to look into the complaints made with respect to frauds in the financial sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lokayukta** is a body operating at the state level to investigate an individual's complaint against public servants or any politician with respect to corruption.
 
• It aims to curb corruption, maladministration, and misuse of power by public servants.
 
• The institution of Lokayukta was established following the model of the Ombudsman in Scandinavian countries.
